16.en: The Conclave begins amid reports of Genestealer Cult insurgencies rising up throughout the Macharian Sector. As characters arrive at Mare Cinis, they find the Inquisitors already in the Conclave chamber, gazing through its glass dome ceiling at Persepolis far below, the unmistakable fires of war cast as faint flickering lights on the planet’s surface. The day of ascension has come.

32.en: In attendance at the sixth Conclave are: @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.b06xyMjo4E4cYc40.JournalEntryPage.sNDdDGlvY5m1HQ4R]{Ksenia Baek}, @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.b06xyMjo4E4cYc40.JournalEntryPage.W50MW8gfyrDts9g3]{Aegidius Halikarn}, @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.b06xyMjo4E4cYc40.JournalEntryPage.CbYL1IrXodXyGuyV]{Sylvestrine Horst}, and @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.b06xyMjo4E4cYc40.JournalEntryPage.9vSAxxrma5zbEIKL]{Alis Raud}. After his time as a captive of the @UUID[.jt0zc7az5xNehcIZ#the-heralds-howl]{Heralds' Howl} Cult, @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.b06xyMjo4E4cYc40.JournalEntryPage.gRAiiRJkLKviH0K5]{Konstan Serranus} returns to the Conclave with a visible increase of augmetic enhancements — among limbs, he has replaced both his eyes with augmetic sensors. Naturally, @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.b06xyMjo4E4cYc40.JournalEntryPage.y8Wjo2ThhVq782nY]{Eskender Thracius} has fled since the last Conclave, his whereabouts remains uncertain. Each present Inquisitor is accompanied by extensive retinues and their Interrogators.

40.en: @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.b06xyMjo4E4cYc40.JournalEntryPage.gRAiiRJkLKviH0K5]{Konstan Serranus} divulges to the Conclave the full extent of the knowledge he has gathered regarding the @UUID[.jt0zc7az5xNehcIZ#the-heralds-howl]{Herald’s Howl} — the vile cultists’ primary aim is to draw the @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.xxcZ1PUz0t1ycevK.JournalEntryPage.GyAY9bnCmCZ3JjzK#tyranids]{Tyranid} Hive Fleets towards the Macharian Sector through the use of multiple psychic beacons, with each system marked on their Star Map iconography being the location of one such beacon.

44.en: If the @UUID[.jt0zc7az5xNehcIZ#the-kryptman-protocol]{Kryptman Protocol} was not already known to the Conclave, whichever Inquisitors are aware of it will reveal it as a potential tool against the Genestealer Cultists and Hive Fleet.

48.en: If the characters have begun to suspect Inquisitor @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.b06xyMjo4E4cYc40.JournalEntryPage.sNDdDGlvY5m1HQ4R]{Ksenia Baek} of Radical behaviour, they could approach Kharket Graan for more information. The astropath has worked for

52.en: for most of their deployment and fears what

56.en: ultimately has in store for her and that the Inquisitor is sliding towards the Radical, allowing them to plant a double agent in

64.en: will use the Herald’s Howl with the Kryptman Protocol to sacrifice the Macharian Sector and stall Leviathan in the name of Holy Terra and Segmentum Solar.

86.en: On the planet below, a battle rages that may determine the fate of the Macharian Sector. As the administrative centre for the sector, the loss of Persepolis, either to the Genestealer Cultists or through their destruction by

98.en: The Conclave is divided. Someone must deal with @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.B7MZBBT3bNew9N96.JournalEntryPage.qLLaIGWiU6Lf6Rjy]{Persopolis}, the sector’s capital world, as the rest of the Macharian Inquisition scatter to quash the @UUID[.jt0zc7az5xNehcIZ#the-heralds-howl]{Herald’s Howl} elsewhere — the Inquisition will be spread thin like it was during the @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.B7MZBBT3bNew9N96.JournalEntryPage.X5EFP7IgIUx6CaBW#silence-and-darkness]{Noctis Aeterna}.

106.en: @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.b06xyMjo4E4cYc40.JournalEntryPage.CbYL1IrXodXyGuyV]{Sylvestrine Horst} has been observing the battlelines of the revolt on @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.B7MZBBT3bNew9N96.JournalEntryPage.qLLaIGWiU6Lf6Rjy]{Persepolis} from the moment it began. She has discerned a pattern of troop movements, with the Genestealer Cultists prioritising the capture of any major communications hubs. She suspects they are communicating with other cells in the sector.

114.en: @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.b06xyMjo4E4cYc40.JournalEntryPage.CbYL1IrXodXyGuyV]{Sylvestrine Horst}, @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.b06xyMjo4E4cYc40.JournalEntryPage.gRAiiRJkLKviH0K5]{Konstan Serranus}, and @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.b06xyMjo4E4cYc40.JournalEntryPage.W50MW8gfyrDts9g3]{Aegidius Halikarn} all argue in favour of deploying forces to @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.B7MZBBT3bNew9N96.JournalEntryPage.qLLaIGWiU6Lf6Rjy]{Persepolis} to undertake scouting and assassination missions to locate and destroy cult leadership, prioritising the presumed Genestealer Patriarch.

122.en: @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.b06xyMjo4E4cYc40.JournalEntryPage.9vSAxxrma5zbEIKL]{Alis Raud} and @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.b06xyMjo4E4cYc40.JournalEntryPage.sNDdDGlvY5m1HQ4R]{Ksenia Baek} advocate supporting the cult's rise and destroying it only before it can claim total victory on @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.B7MZBBT3bNew9N96.JournalEntryPage.qLLaIGWiU6Lf6Rjy]{Persepolis}. This would allow the cultists to use the communications networks to rouse the the wider @UUID[.jt0zc7az5xNehcIZ#the-heralds-howl]{Herald's Howl}, tricking the cult into revealing itself across the sector.

130.en: If the characters seek to resolve this Strife, their Patron has enough sway with the Conclave to approach this mission in whichever manner the players advise.

140.en: The characters deploy to Persepolis, finding the planet wracked by the spreading conflict. Even if they manage to quell the Genesteaeler’s Cultists' initial strikes and their part in the Herald’s Howl, it could take them years to track down and purge the last of them.

152.en: Note that any missions the characters undertake on the surface will inevitably bear the risk of engaging in combat, and their Patron advises they bring the greatest complement of weaponry they can gather. If there is anything the characters need or have been asking for a long time, the stockpiles at @UUID[.Y1wjtyi7JdgHxQiF#mare-cinis]{Mare Cinis} should be open to them.

160.en: @UUID[.jt0zc7az5xNehcIZ#the-heralds-howl]{Herald’s Howl}: The Conclave arranges for the characters to have access to Sector Lord @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.B7MZBBT3bNew9N96.JournalEntryPage.X5EFP7IgIUx6CaBW#governance]{Aulus Sejanus’s} war room in the spire of @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.B7MZBBT3bNew9N96.JournalEntryPage.qLLaIGWiU6Lf6Rjy#hive-skarthius]{Hive Skarthius}. Sejanus recognises their involvement as a vital means of tipping the scales of this revolt in his favour and shares any information with them that could prove helpful in determining where to strike. With access to a wing of Valkyries for swift deployment and extraction, missions to defeat the uprising may include:

168.en: Surveillance missions to root out and detect priority targets.

176.en: Hunts for Genestealer Cultist Maguses, tacticians, and field commanders.

184.en: Investigating organisations who may have aided in the Cult’s rise to power.

192.en: These missions will likely culminate in a strike to destroy the Genestealer Patriarch, located deep in the lower levels of @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.B7MZBBT3bNew9N96.JournalEntryPage.qLLaIGWiU6Lf6Rjy#hive-skarthius]{Hive Skarthius}, orchestrating the cult's revolt from below ground. By now, their insurgency is so deeply rooted that purging them could be a ripe task for the @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.brh2O5CexxurRbM7.JournalEntryPage.YFKg8L1rfWbScqkr#the-deathwatch]{Deathwatch}.

198.en: Fighting to see the Cults rise

200.en: : The characters deploy to an Inquisitorial safehouse in hive Skarthius. The Inquisition will not undertake military actions themselves, as any direct engagement would put characters into a battle on two fronts — the Genestealer Cultists would not recognise them as allies, and those defending the planet would treat them as part of the revolt. If captured, execution is near certain, although characters may be able to level Inquisitorial authority or their support of the revolt to buy their escape. Their missions to aid the Genestealer Cultists may include:

208.en: Sabotaging Imperial supply lines and transport links.

216.en: Luring defenders away from Genestealer Cultist activity.

224.en: Ensuring Genestealer Cultists capture communication arrays across the planet.

232.en: Once the Genestealer Cultists capture the planet’s hive cities, the operation is deemed a success. The characters will be extracted while arrangements are made to begin a counteroffensive. Again, this task would suit Deathwatch involvement, but the characters may have difficulty hiding their underhanded motives from these stalwart Marines.

240.en: Completing their operation on @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.B7MZBBT3bNew9N96.JournalEntryPage.qLLaIGWiU6Lf6Rjy]{Persepolis} earns the characters’ Patron +2 Legitimacy. Otherwise, it is undertaken by another Inquisitor, one who sided with their Patron (@UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.b06xyMjo4E4cYc40.JournalEntryPage.CbYL1IrXodXyGuyV]{Sylvestrine Horst} for defending Persepolis, @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.b06xyMjo4E4cYc40.JournalEntryPage.sNDdDGlvY5m1HQ4R]{Ksenia Baek} for supporting the uprising), who gains +2 Legitimacy.

248.en: : The wider @UUID[.jt0zc7az5xNehcIZ#the-heralds-howl]{Herald's Howl} is roused to war in a piecemeal manner, with many smaller cells remaining in the shadows, unaware of the wider uprising. @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.B7MZBBT3bNew9N96.JournalEntryPage.qLLaIGWiU6Lf6Rjy]{Persepolis} is, however, able to function as the fulcrum of the Imperium’s counteroffensive, and the cults that do emerge face swift retribution from Macharian @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.6hX0E9XlPUoRaDaQ.JournalEntryPage.6Yav4onpokz5e5jg]{Astra Militarum} regiments, although a few are able to annihilate initial Imperial attacks in ambushes and guerilla engagements.

256.en: : The@UUID[.jt0zc7az5xNehcIZ#the-heralds-howl]{ Herald's Howl} emerge from their hidden places across the Macharian Sector, a united force that wreaks havoc in its emergence, but loses its element of surprise against Imperial reinforcements, having wasted their advantage against local forces. The loss of Persepolis, however, causes catastrophic logistical problems for the Imperial Forces, losing their central hub of authority over the sector.

278.en: Amid the reports of the sector-spanning Genestealer Cult uprising, six planets that correlate with the recovered Star Map have drawn the attention of the Conclave: Ctesias, Opis, Faustina IV, Cyzicus, Vantaer, and Telekar.

286.en: These planets on the edge of the Macharian Sector each have significant strategic importance in the form of resources that could supply the @UUID[.jt0zc7az5xNehcIZ#the-heralds-howl]{Herald's Howl} for an extended campaign, including the forge and hive worlds of Ctesias, Opis, and Faustina IV for manufacturing and the agri worlds Cyzicus and Vantaer for provisioning.

290.en: On each affected planet, the defenders have been pushed to a tipping point and will be overwhelmed without concentrated immediate action from the Inquisitors on all six planets. Inquisitorial strike forces would have to be deployed in a protracted campaign to destroy the Patriarchs on each planet — potentially robbing the Conclave of the capability to defend @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.B7MZBBT3bNew9N96.JournalEntryPage.qLLaIGWiU6Lf6Rjy]{Persepolis}. Such a campaign would have to begin with strikes to disable anti-air defences, already controlled by @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.xxcZ1PUz0t1ycevK.JournalEntryPage.GyAY9bnCmCZ3JjzK#tyranids]{Genestealer Cultists} on each affected planet, repelling any attempts to undertake orbital strikes against the cultists.

294.en: The only other option is to activate the @UUID[.jt0zc7az5xNehcIZ#the-kryptman-protocol]{Kryptman Protocol}. While fleet captains may be hesitant to enact

298.en: with their vessels at risk from planetary defences, the sleeper agents conditioned by Inquisitor Lord Drake will follow such orders with little concern for their safety. Sacrificing the border worlds is no decision made lightly — many of the worlds that the Kryptman Protocol would destroy are unaffected by these uprisings and are home to vital resources for the Imperium, including agri worlds, hive worlds, and forge worlds. Their loss will have dreadful long-term effects for the sector’s capacity to defend itself. Collectively, they are also home to hundreds of billions.

306.en: @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.b06xyMjo4E4cYc40.JournalEntryPage.gRAiiRJkLKviH0K5]{Konstan Serranus} is the leading proponent of using the @UUID[.jt0zc7az5xNehcIZ#the-kryptman-protocol]{Kryptman Protocol}. In his eyes, the worlds that have already become infested by @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.xxcZ1PUz0t1ycevK.JournalEntryPage.GyAY9bnCmCZ3JjzK#tyranids]{Genestealer Cults} are damned, while those left untouched will merely be the next to fall in a disaster that will damn the entire Macharian Sector unless swift, bold action is taken.

314.en: @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.b06xyMjo4E4cYc40.JournalEntryPage.CbYL1IrXodXyGuyV]{Sylvestrine Horst} is Serranus’ greatest opposition, considering the long-term costs of using the @UUID[.jt0zc7az5xNehcIZ#the-kryptman-protocol]{Kryptman Protocol} too extreme for its use to benefit the Macharian Sector.

322.en: @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.b06xyMjo4E4cYc40.JournalEntryPage.W50MW8gfyrDts9g3]{Aegidius Halikarn} sees aiding the border worlds as an opportunity to rebuild their political order to align with his @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.brh2O5CexxurRbM7.JournalEntryPage.7Aqg1D2wSmKjmzWj]{Recongregationist} philosophy in the wake of the conflict.

330.en: Whether characters choose to undertake this operation or favour activating the @UUID[.jt0zc7az5xNehcIZ#the-kryptman-protocol]{Kryptman Protocol} so that their attention may be focused on @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.B7MZBBT3bNew9N96.JournalEntryPage.qLLaIGWiU6Lf6Rjy]{Persepolis}, it should be their Patron who makes the deciding argument for or against using the Kryptman Protocol.

340.en: As the Conclave scatters to save the sector, Characters race to deploy on the world of Telekar and begin their campaign of resistance against the occupying Genestealer Cult.

346.en: The characters must undertake a series of covert missions if they undertake an operation to recapture the border worlds. This includes scouting, sabotaging planetary defences, and assassinating the @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.xxcZ1PUz0t1ycevK.JournalEntryPage.GyAY9bnCmCZ3JjzK#tyranids]{Genestealer Cultists’} chain of command. Time is of the essence, but discretion is essential on these enemy-occupied planets. Several of the captured planets are still home to loyalists holding out or waging guerilla war against the Genestealer Cultists, and characters who discover and rendezvous with such cells of resistance may find the loyalists to have vital local knowledge or intel on the Genestealer Cult forces.

350.en: Once anti-air defences are disabled and the Genestealer Cults are in disarray, @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.GPqYZykonC12TJb1.JournalEntryPage.HlxK2pbpx2Uio6bU]{Navis Imperialis} and @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.6hX0E9XlPUoRaDaQ.JournalEntryPage.6Yav4onpokz5e5jg]{Astra Militarum} forces can move to undertake orbital strikes and ground invasions, but with each reclaimed world, paranoia among the @UUID[.jt0zc7az5xNehcIZ#the-heralds-howl]{Herald's Howl} only increases on those yet to fall — warnings of the characters’ operations passed between the cultists lead to heightened security. Elite Genestealer Cultists and @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-actors.Actor.KvLrPAQ0gmIWSvfX]{Purestrain Genestealers} are deployed to hunt the characters progressively as the operation continues.

354.en: Finally, they must deal with the psychic beacon at the heart of each cult’s operation and likely the most well-defended structure under cultist control. Total purgation is likely the best method to ensure the @UUID[.jt0zc7az5xNehcIZ#the-heralds-howl]{Howl} is ceased, but any Inquisitor seeking to study the Herald’s Howl further may attempt to contain the horror through a greater psychic force, technology, or using blanks. Most would consider it heresy to meddle with such monstrosities; any failures to contain it may result in Warp breaches and daemonic activity rising in the area.

362.en: If characters successfully undertake the operation to destroy the @UUID[.jt0zc7az5xNehcIZ#the-heralds-howl]{Herald's Howl} on the border worlds, their Patron gains +2 Legitimacy. If the border worlds are saved, it is accomplished at a terrible cost to the affected planets, with many functionally refounded during the conquest following the characters’ operations.

366.en: If the characters do not undertake this operation, it falls to @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.b06xyMjo4E4cYc40.JournalEntryPage.W50MW8gfyrDts9g3]{Aegidius Halikarn} or @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.b06xyMjo4E4cYc40.JournalEntryPage.gRAiiRJkLKviH0K5]{Konstan Serranus}, depending on the decision made regarding the @UUID[.jt0zc7az5xNehcIZ#the-kryptman-protocol]{Kryptman Protocol}.

370.en: @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.b06xyMjo4E4cYc40.JournalEntryPage.W50MW8gfyrDts9g3]{Aegidius Halikarn} undertakes the operation to liberate the border worlds, losing many acolytes in intense skirmishes, clearing a path for Imperial forces to reclaim the lost planets, earning +2 Legitimacy.

374.en: @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.b06xyMjo4E4cYc40.JournalEntryPage.gRAiiRJkLKviH0K5]{Konstan Serranus} activates the @UUID[.jt0zc7az5xNehcIZ#the-kryptman-protocol]{Kryptman protocols}, destroying the border worlds and, with them, the logistical strength of the Herald's Howl, earning +2 Legitimacy, but at atrocious cost.

382.en: Beyond Conclave VI’s Strifes, each Inquisitor undertakes dozens of missions with their acolytes to stem the tide of @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.xxcZ1PUz0t1ycevK.JournalEntryPage.GyAY9bnCmCZ3JjzK#tyranids]{Genestealer Cult} uprisings and end the @UUID[.jt0zc7az5xNehcIZ#the-heralds-howl]{Herald’s Howl}.

390.en: @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.b06xyMjo4E4cYc40.JournalEntryPage.sNDdDGlvY5m1HQ4R]{Ksenia Baek} aids Imperial forces on numerous battlelines; she takes more dangerous and sacrificial actions to contain the @UUID[.jt0zc7az5xNehcIZ#the-heralds-howl]{Herald’s Howl} rather than destroy their psychic beacons. The characters may already have an informant in her retinue (perhaps in the form of Kharket Graan). The informant relays that

394.en: has been negotiating with some cells of the Herald's Howl, albeit for seemingly loyalist aims, and sending related messages to her @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.brh2O5CexxurRbM7.JournalEntryPage.0vHms9BJQGOVa0dO]{Thorian} peers back on Holy Terra about the Herald’s Howl and the @UUID[.jt0zc7az5xNehcIZ#the-kryptman-protocol]{Kryptman Protocol}.

402.en: The wrath of @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.b06xyMjo4E4cYc40.JournalEntryPage.W50MW8gfyrDts9g3]{Aegidius Halikarn} falls upon @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.B7MZBBT3bNew9N96.JournalEntryPage.59y8WFXTbwKRwiRI]{Voll}, on which a @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.xxcZ1PUz0t1ycevK.JournalEntryPage.GyAY9bnCmCZ3JjzK#tyranids]{Genestealer Cult} uprising had largely already succeeded, declaring their commanding Magus the hive world’s new planetary governor.

406.en: arms and orchestrates a counter-revolution of Imperial loyalists against the @UUID[.jt0zc7az5xNehcIZ#the-heralds-howl]{Herald's Howl}, culminating in the Inquisitor personally slaying the usurper planetary governor.

414.en: @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.b06xyMjo4E4cYc40.JournalEntryPage.CbYL1IrXodXyGuyV]{Sylvestrine Horst} strikes where the fighting is thickest, focusing her defensive efforts on worlds of the most significant strategic importance. On a dozen battlefronts, the tide turns for Imperial forces when reinforcements arrive in the form of the Inquisitor’s saint-masked acolytes. Her greatest triumph is the defence of @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.B7MZBBT3bNew9N96.JournalEntryPage.BKMxau7cO5Cy5aXX]{Dao Teyras}. Still, her forces see deployment across the sector, defending Imperial command from the hive spires of @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.B7MZBBT3bNew9N96.JournalEntryPage.0g60Fj0fRMDfzYGB]{Macharia} to the city ships of @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.B7MZBBT3bNew9N96.JournalEntryPage.wHl3ZP7wM7OQvSLC]{Jotungarth}.

422.en: @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.b06xyMjo4E4cYc40.JournalEntryPage.9vSAxxrma5zbEIKL]{Alis Raud} personally engages @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.xxcZ1PUz0t1ycevK.JournalEntryPage.GyAY9bnCmCZ3JjzK#tyranids]{Genestealer Cult}-controlled voidships in the @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.B7MZBBT3bNew9N96.JournalEntryPage.d0lv2v4FkeIb43jj]{Drimor Subsector}, drawing them into a void battle in the turbulent depths of the @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.B7MZBBT3bNew9N96.JournalEntryPage.1AsBzkbw2InKayw2]{Ayzinith Abyss}, a largely uncharted region of space that she deftly navigates with such success as to suggest a more profound knowledge of the area. In truth,

426.en: helps the defence from the sidelines, as a lead on the disappeared heretic @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.B7MZBBT3bNew9N96.JournalEntryPage.X5EFP7IgIUx6CaBW#machariuss-generals]{General Cyrus} has come to light — a threat she deems even more pressing than the @UUID[.jt0zc7az5xNehcIZ#the-heralds-howl]{Herald's Howl}.

434.en: @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.b06xyMjo4E4cYc40.JournalEntryPage.gRAiiRJkLKviH0K5]{Konstan Serranus} is a vengeful man, and his wrath falls upon the @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.xxcZ1PUz0t1ycevK.JournalEntryPage.GyAY9bnCmCZ3JjzK#tyranids]{Genestealer Cultists} on @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.B7MZBBT3bNew9N96.JournalEntryPage.VeiDfnkV55kTAkRw]{Kallastin}. Aware of their numbers and tactics after his captivity,

438.en: mobilises an army of the Machine God, gathered from his @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.6hX0E9XlPUoRaDaQ.JournalEntryPage.9frbPZ9v3lFR9Kva]{Adeptus Mechanicus} allies on @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.B7MZBBT3bNew9N96.JournalEntryPage.jB9sg2SDLZJGZrac]{Eskutchax}. The augmented Inquisitor, his acolytes, and an army of skitarii and battle servitors fall upon the Genestealer Cults with mechanical fury, and

442.en: is thorough in his purging of any among the Highborn of Kallastin that he believes may be allied to the cultists.

450.en: Despite being a traitor in the eyes of several Inquisitors of the Conclave, @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.b06xyMjo4E4cYc40.JournalEntryPage.y8Wjo2ThhVq782nY]{Eskender Thracius} believes he is loyal to the Imperium and fights against the @UUID[.jt0zc7az5xNehcIZ#the-heralds-howl]{Herald's Howl} with a zeal to match any other Inquisitor.

454.en: ’ acolytes, armed with esoteric @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.xxcZ1PUz0t1ycevK.JournalEntryPage.GyAY9bnCmCZ3JjzK#aeldari]{Aeldari} weaponry, come to the beleaguered Imperial forces on @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.B7MZBBT3bNew9N96.JournalEntryPage.nLrpWOo3BjHLB0FG]{Proteus Secundus}, arriving disguised as the Rogue Trader Selim Iaysus. He will be remembered by the people of the Proteus system for his heroism, personally leading his crew to board a @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.xxcZ1PUz0t1ycevK.JournalEntryPage.GyAY9bnCmCZ3JjzK#tyranids]{Genestealer Cult}-controlled battleship and slay their Patriarch with the strange technology gathered on his travels.

468.en: As the last fires of the @UUID[.jt0zc7az5xNehcIZ#the-heralds-howl]{Herald's Howl} uprising die across the Macharian Sector, the forces of the Inquisition, instrumental in the Imperial victory, fade back into the shadows. With the greatest threat to the Macharian Sector seemingly defeated, Inquisitorial machinations are once again in motion, both loyalist and heretical…
